options.content:
# Active Directory Services (ADDS)

Azure Monitoring Packs

azureLogAnalytics.query:
Perf
| where CounterName == '% Processor Time'
| summarize by Computer, TimeGenerated, CounterValue

Perf
| where CounterName == 'Available Bytes'
| summarize by Computer, TimeGenerated, CounterValue

Perf
| where CounterName == 'LDAP Client Sessions'
| summarize by Computer, TimeGenerated, CounterValue

Perf
| where CounterName == 'Total Query Received/sec'
| summarize by Computer, TimeGenerated, CounterValue

addsmonitoring_CL
| parse RawData with TimeIngested "," Metric "," Value "," remainder
| where Metric =~ 'ADDSlsassCPU'
| project TimeGenerated, Value=toint(Value)

addsmonitoring_CL
| parse RawData with TimeIngested "," Metric "," Value "," remainder
| where Metric =~ 'ADLogFileDriveDiskSpacePctUsed'
| project TimeGenerated, Value=todouble(Value)

options.content:
# Pick a Counter: "${PerformanceCounters}"

Select a Counter at the top of the dashboard

azureLogAnalytics.query:
Perf
| where CounterName == '$PerformanceCounters'
| summarize by Computer, TimeGenerated, CounterValue

addsmonitoring_CL
| extend fields=split(RawData,',')
| extend MetricName=tostring(fields[1]), Value=todouble(fields[2]), Tags=tostring(fields[3])
| where MetricName == 'ADBindSuccess'
| summarize BindOk=max(Value)

addsmonitoring_CL
| extend fields=split(RawData,',')
| extend MetricName=tostring(fields[1]), Value=todouble(fields[2]), Tags=tostring(fields[3])
| where MetricName == 'ADGCReachable'
| summarize GCOk=max(Value)

addsmonitoring_CL
| extend fields=split(RawData,',')
| extend MetricName=tostring(fields[1]), Value=todouble(fields[2]), Tags=tostring(fields[3])
| where MetricName == 'ADSysVolAccessible'
| summarize SysvolOk=max(Value)

addsmonitoring_CL
| extend fields=split(RawData,',')
| extend MetricName=tostring(fields[1]), Value=todouble(fields[2]), Tags=tostring(fields[3])
| where MetricName == 'ADNetLogonAccessible'
| summarize NetlogonOk=max(Value)

let latestBatch = toscalar(addsmonitoring_CL | summarize max(TimeGenerated));
addsmonitoring_CL
| where TimeGenerated == latestBatch
| extend fields=split(RawData,',')
| extend MetricName=tostring(fields[1]), Value=todouble(fields[2]), Tags=tostring(fields[3])
| where MetricName == 'ADReplConsecutiveFailures'
| extend Partner=extract('replPartner\":\"([^\"]+)', 1, Tags), Partition=extract('replPartition\":\"([^\"]+)', 1, Tags), LastSuccess=extract('lastSuccess\":\"([^\"]+)', 1, Tags)
| project Partner, Partition, Failures=Value, LastSuccess, _ResourceId

let latestBatch = toscalar(addsmonitoring_CL | summarize max(TimeGenerated));
addsmonitoring_CL
| where TimeGenerated == latestBatch
| extend fields=split(RawData,',')
| extend MetricName=tostring(fields[1]), Value=todouble(fields[2]), Tags=tostring(fields[3])
| where MetricName == 'ADFSMOReachable'
| extend Role=extract('fsmoRole\":\"([^\"]+)', 1, Tags), Holder=extract('fsmoHolder\":\"([^\"]+)', 1, Tags)
| project Role, Holder, Reachable=Value, _ResourceId

addsmonitoring_CL
| extend fields=split(RawData,',')
| extend MetricName=tostring(fields[1]), Value=todouble(fields[2]), Tags=tostring(fields[3])
| where MetricName == 'ADTimeSkew'
| project TimeGenerated, Value

addsmonitoring_CL
| extend fields=split(RawData,',')
| extend MetricName=tostring(fields[1]), Value=todouble(fields[2]), Tags=tostring(fields[3])
| where MetricName == 'ADBindTimeMs'
| project TimeGenerated, Value

addsmonitoring_CL
| extend fields=split(RawData,',')
| extend MetricName=tostring(fields[1]), Value=todouble(fields[2]), Tags=tostring(fields[3])
| where MetricName == 'ADGCResponseMs'
| project TimeGenerated, Value

addsmonitoring_CL
| extend fields=split(RawData,',')
| extend MetricName=tostring(fields[1]), Value=todouble(fields[2]), Tags=tostring(fields[3])
| where MetricName == 'ADReplPendingOps'
| project TimeGenerated, Value

addsmonitoring_CL
| extend fields=split(RawData,',')
| extend MetricName=tostring(fields[1]), Value=todouble(fields[2]), Tags=tostring(fields[3])
| where MetricName == 'ADAtqThreadUsagePct'
| project TimeGenerated, Value

addsmonitoring_CL
| extend fields=split(RawData,',')
| extend MetricName=tostring(fields[1]), Value=todouble(fields[2]), Tags=tostring(fields[3])
| where MetricName == 'ADRIDPoolFree'
| summarize FreeRIDs=min(Value)
